nodes.label: Inline Validation via Disabled CTA with Hint Text
nodes.norm_label: inline validation via disabled cta with hint text
nodes.rationale: Instead of blocking with an alert on save, the form shows the first failing rule ('Thêm ít nhất một sản phẩm') directly above a dimmed save button that still displays the running total, so the user knows both why they cannot save and what the order currently amounts to.

nodes.label: Single Long-Scroll Grouped Form Pattern
nodes.rationale: The whole order is captured on one vertically scrolling sheet with inset grouped cards and uppercase section headers, so a florist can enter a customer order quickly during a chat/phone call without navigating multiple screens. Pink accent marks the selected chip/segment and primary actions; the sticky bottom CTA shows the live total and is disabled until at least one product exists, giving inline validation feedback.
